h1:
9 Sattahip Hotels in Chonburi
Quiet, Seaside, Easy on the Budget
That We've Reviewed
heroSub: 9 hand-picked stays in the Sattahip area, Sattahip District, Chonburi Province (the southernmost Pattaya zone) that we've reviewed in depth — bayfront guesthouses with the sea filling the window, hilltop rooms that catch the breeze, coconut-garden villas, houses with kitchens, and budget resorts near the naval base, from around ฿585–1,600/night.
heroStats: ✅ Honest takes from real reviews at every stay
introH2: 🏖️ How many kinds of stays are there in Sattahip, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Sattahip is a seaside district at the southern tip of Chonburi Province, just past Pattaya, and that's exactly the appeal drawing more people to look for a place to stay around here — it still holds the feel of a small seaside town and a navy community, unlike Pattaya buzzing with international tourists · Stays in the Sattahip area don't all look the same — some are small bayfront guesthouses where you open the window and the sea fills your view, some are hilltop rooms where you wake to a cool breeze and a bay view from above, some are coconut-garden villas or houses with kitchens where you can cook your own meals, and some are light-budget resorts near the naval base for people here on official business · The shared thing to know before booking is that Sattahip is easiest with your own car or a rental, because public transport isn't as dense as in Pattaya city · This article gathers 9 stays in the Sattahip area that we've reviewed in depth — by the sea, on the hill, in a garden, and in town — every one drawn from reading guests' real reviews, telling both the upsides and the honest caveats, prices compared across 3 sites, with direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Sattahip has no metro and limited public transport, so having your own car or a rental is easiest · The key reference point is U-Tapao Airport (UTP), only about 12–18 km, or 15–25 min by car, from the stays in this article — ideal for anyone flying in directly · The main lodging areas in this article: Sattahip bayfront / old market — by the sea, bay views, walking distance to the morning market and Wat Sattahip (Baan Sattahip, Sattahiptale) · Sattahip town — quiet, near the naval base and the market, about a 10–15 min drive to the beach (SiriNiran, Baan Klang-Dao, My Home, Sor Kor Sor) · Dongtan/Nang Ram beach zone and the hills — near the clear-water beaches and the high viewpoints (Pob Choke, Makmai Sailom Heights, The Brass Villa) · From Sattahip into Pattaya city is about a 30–50 min drive.

entries.name: The Brass Villa Garden Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sukhumvit Rd, Sattahip · near Sattahip Beach, 5–10 min
entries.addr: 27/35 Moo 6, Sukhumvit Road, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: We open with the stay that sells quiet most clearly of the group, The Brass Villa Garden Resort — a cluster of small villas, about 9–10 rooms, set in a shady garden planted with coconut trees, tucked off Sukhumvit Road into a quiet corner of the Sattahip area, with the feeling of staying at a garden house rather than checking into a hotel · If you're on the Pattaya side but don't want the bustle of Pattaya city, this is an answer you won't find often in a zone that mostly sells buzz · The point real reviews agree on is that the rooms are fairly new, modern in their decor, clean, with cold air-con and soundproof windows that make for easy sleep — many use the words "clean, new, quiet" and praise the coconut garden that keeps the atmosphere cool and shaded, good for sipping morning coffee or letting the kids run around · It's a small stay where the staff look after you closely and are friendly, happy to recommend restaurants and sights around Sattahip, with free private parking that's wide and easy, near U-Tapao Airport at about 12 km (15–20 min) and near Sattahip Beach and the Krom Luang Chumphon Memorial at about 5–10 min · Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a small stay, so facilities and services aren't as complete as a big hotel, the location is easiest with your own car since it's about 30–40 min from Pattaya city, and details like breakfast and the swimming pool are listed inconsistently across some platforms, so check with the property directly before booking · Best for couples, small families, and people driving themselves who want to sleep to the quiet of the garden and head out to the beaches around Sattahip during the day.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're flying into U-Tapao, make the most of the short distance to the airport — arrange a pickup or have a rental car ready in advance · And check with the property directly about breakfast and the swimming pool before booking, since they're listed inconsistently across some channels.
pros: Quiet villas in a coconut garden, away from the bustle of Pattaya city
Rooms fairly new and clean, cold air-con, soundproof windows for easy sleep (from reviews)
Friendly, attentive staff · free private parking
Near Sattahip Beach and U-Tapao Airport, about 15–20 min
cons: It's a small stay, facilities not as complete as a big hotel
Location easiest with a car, about 30–40 min from Pattaya city
Breakfast/pool details listed inconsistently, check directly

entries.name: Baan Sattahip by the sea
entries.badge: 🌊 On the bay · every room a sea view
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chai Thale Rd, Sattahip · walk to the morning market & Wat Sattahip
entries.addr: 311/6-8 Moo 1, Chai Thale Road, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: If you go by review scores, Baan Sattahip by the sea is the top scorer in this article at 9.2 — a small guesthouse of about 5 rooms, converted from a three-storey shophouse on the seaside road into a warm, holiday-home-style stay, open since around 2021 · Its stance is clear right from the name "by the sea," because the building sits right on the bay and is designed so that most rooms face the sea with a view of Sattahip Bay, which is what real reviews mention most — many even call it a "million-dollar view" · The next most consistently praised point is the service — many reviews speak of the warm welcome and the friendliness of the owner and staff, many use the words "warmest staff," and feel more like staying at a friend's house than checking into a hotel · There's an in-house cafe to sip coffee and watch the bay in the morning, breakfast included in the room rate, free Wi-Fi and parking, and it's within walking distance of the Sattahip morning market and Wat Sattahip (Luang Pho I) · Honest caveats: there's no swimming pool, since it mainly sells the seaside atmosphere, the rooms are fairly compact because it's a small building, soundproofing from the corridor is so-so, the breakfast menu has limited choices, and some reviews feel the price is a touch high for the room size · Best for couples and anyone who wants to sleep to the sound of the sea and wake to a bay view filling the window, as long as you pick a sea-facing room carefully and set your expectations right.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The view is the star here, but not every room gets the same one — ask for a room that faces the sea with a bay-view window right when you book · Soundproofing is so-so, so if you're sensitive to noise pick a room away from the main corridor and pack earplugs.
pros: Top score in the article at 9.2 · most rooms with a full Sattahip bay view
Owner and staff give a warm, friendly welcome and close care
Seaside cafe to chill in the morning · breakfast included · free parking
Walk to the morning market and Wat Sattahip, near U-Tapao about 20–25 min
cons: No swimming pool (sells the seaside atmosphere)
Compact rooms · so-so soundproofing from the corridor
Limited breakfast menu · some reviews feel the price is a touch high

entries.type: Boutique Guesthouse & Hostel · old market on the bay
entries.name: Sattahiptale Boutique Guesthouse & Hostel
entries.badge: 🌅 Rooftop bay view · dorms from a few hundred
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sattahip old market · walk to the morning market and temple
entries.addr: 132 Liab Chai Thale Road, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: If you want to feel Sattahip the way locals actually live it, Sattahiptale Boutique Guesthouse & Hostel is the answer with the most heart of the group — a small guesthouse of about 12 rooms converted from an old waterfront shophouse in the Sattahip old-market fishing village, decorated and run by the owner personally, scoring 9.0 from 15 reviews on Trip.com and 4.3/5 on Tripadvisor (ranked #5 of 25 specialty stays in Sattahip) · The highlight every review agrees on is the rooftop bay view — go up and you see fishing boats lined up, small islands in the middle of the bay, and the sunset, with a little bar open on Friday–Sunday evenings where solo travelers make new friends · There's a range from dorm beds from a few hundred baht up to private rooms from ฿800, good for backpackers, laid-back couples, and people driving or riding a scooter around themselves · A few steps away is the Sattahip morning market full of fresh seafood, near Wat Sattahip and the boat pier out to Koh Samaesan, and reviews repeat "It's not a hotel, it's your home" · Honest caveats: it's a converted old shophouse, so some rooms and bathrooms are fairly small, there's no lift so you take the stairs, no swimming pool, getting around Sattahip requires your own vehicle, and some older reviews have noted cleanliness in certain periods · Best for people who value atmosphere and sincerity over luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Head up to the rooftop at sunset, and if you want the full bar atmosphere, stay a Friday–Sunday night when the bar is open · Check-in is 14:00–20:00 with no 24-hour front desk — contact the owner via Facebook or call ahead, especially if you're arriving late.
pros: Rooftop bay view, fishing boats, and sunset are the number-one highlight
Owner-run, warm and friendly, with good sightseeing tips
Both dorms from a few hundred and private rooms, great value for the experience
In the heart of the fishing village, walk to the morning market and Wat Sattahip
cons: Converted old shophouse, compact rooms, no lift so you take the stairs
No swimming pool · getting around Sattahip requires your own vehicle
Some older reviews have noted cleanliness in certain periods

entries.name: SiriNiran Resort
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.7 · Booking 8.5 · from hundreds of guests
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Thetsaban 99, Sattahip town · U-Tapao 15–20 min
entries.addr: 13-15 Soi Thetsaban 99, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: SiriNiran Resort is a small resort of about 18–20 rooms on Soi Thetsaban 99 in the heart of Sattahip town, selling "value and peace of mind" more than luxury — and what sets it apart in the eyes of real reviews is the staff's service, which scores notably higher than the other categories · Many reviews use the words friendly, smiling, and helpful — with late check-in, calling a taxi in the early morning before a flight, and recommending restaurants — and many say it feels more like staying at a relative's house than being a room number · The biggest location advantage is that it's only about a 15–20 min drive from U-Tapao Airport, ideal for anyone who flies in and wants to stay near the airport before or after a flight, or who's here on official business around Sattahip · Every room has air-con, a fridge, and a TV, with free parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, and a BBQ corner to grill and eat together as a group, from just ฿700/night · Honest caveats: set your expectations right — this is a budget stay in town, not a beachfront resort, so you have to drive out to the beach, the real condition of some rooms doesn't match the photos online, some rooms have a damp smell in the bathroom, the kettle and microwave are in a shared area, and there's no swimming pool · Best for anyone who wants a clean, quiet, budget air-con room with good service, especially people using U-Tapao as their fly-in/out point.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To make the most of the location near U-Tapao, share your flight time and ask the property to help call a taxi in advance, especially for early-morning flights · If you care about room condition and cleanliness, pick a VIP or non-smoking room and read the latest reviews alongside.
pros: Staff service scores notably high, looked after like family
Location near U-Tapao Airport ~15–20 min · 24-hour front desk
Budget price from ฿700 · free parking · BBQ corner
Clean linens and towels, cold air-con, quiet room for easy sleep (from reviews)
cons: In town, not on the sea and no pool, you have to drive to the beach
Some rooms don't match the online photos, some have a damp smell
Kettle/microwave in a shared area · this area needs a car

entries.type: Small House Resort 2★ · houses with kitchens
entries.name: Baan Klang-Dao Resort (Sattahip)
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.7 · Trip.com 8.3 · from hundreds of reviews
entries.badge: 🏡 Separate houses with kitchens · seafood BBQ
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sattahip town · drive to Dongtan Beach 10–15 min
entries.addr: 73/185 Moo 5, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Baan Klang-Dao Resort (Sattahip) differs from the others in the group in its format — a small resort of about 8 houses designed as separate houses divided into a living room, bedroom, kitchen, and a private balcony/yard, not a single all-in-one hotel room, giving high privacy like staying at a holiday house, open since around 2017, averaging about 8.7 from hundreds of reviews on Agoda · The point real reviews most agree on is the newness, cleanliness, and quiet — many say "very clean" and "soft bedding for easy sleep," plus service that's warm "like family," with cleanliness and service categories on booking platforms scoring around 9 out of 10 · Many houses have a kitchen with a fridge and stove to cook your own meals, which families and groups of friends love because it's economical and convenient for multi-day stays, plus an in-house seafood BBQ that reviews praise as tasty, where you can set up and eat in the yard out front, with free parking, near U-Tapao Airport at about 16 km (20 min) · Honest caveats: the location is in town, not on the beach, so you have to drive about 10–15 min to the sea, there's no swimming pool, facilities are limited, the seafood BBQ leans premium in price, and breakfast isn't included in every package · Best for families and groups of friends who want a quiet private house, to cook their own meals, and to set up a BBQ.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Each house differs slightly in size and facilities — ask whether it has a full kitchen, how many beds, and the size of the house you'll stay in right when you book, especially if you're coming as a group · If you plan to use the seafood BBQ service, ask the price and give notice in advance, since it leans premium.
pros: Separate houses laid out with a living room, bedroom, and kitchen
New, very clean, good-quality bedding, quiet for easy sleep (from reviews)
Warm, family-like service · in-house seafood BBQ
Free parking · near U-Tapao Airport about 20 min
cons: In-town location, not on the beach, drive 10–15 min to the sea
No swimming pool, limited facilities
Seafood BBQ leans premium in price · some packages exclude breakfast

entries.name: My Home Hotel (Baan Mai Hom Hotel)
entries.badge: 🌳 Has a swimming pool · free parking
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Sattahip-Sukhumvit 59 · near Toei Ngam & Nang Ram beaches
entries.addr: 11/44 Soi Sattahip-Sukhumvit 59, Moo 7, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Among the Sattahip stays we've reviewed, My Home Hotel, or by its Thai name Baan Mai Hom Hotel, is the only full-service hotel and the only one with a swimming pool on site — a 3-star hotel of about 41 rooms on Soi Sattahip-Sukhumvit 59 in central Sattahip town, the building finished in wood mixed with concrete in line with its name "Baan Mai Hom" (fragrant wood house), with a green garden and an outdoor swimming pool in the middle of the building, a calm, shaded holiday-house feel · The point real reviews praise most is that rooms are clean and more spacious than the price, with comfortable beds, cold air-con, and good value (some platforms rate the value category as high as around 9.0), plus what sets it apart from a typical budget stay — it has a meeting/seminar room and a banquet space that serve official events and parties in the Sattahip district, an in-house restaurant/coffee shop that reviews praise for tasty Thai food served fast, and wide, easy free parking · The Deluxe Twin during promotions starts at around ฿800/night, and there are also pool-view villa rooms for those who want more privacy · Near Toei Ngam Beach, Nang Ram Beach, and Wat Khao Noi, about 17 km from U-Tapao · Honest caveats: many rooms at the starting rate don't include breakfast, Sattahip town still relies mainly on a car and isn't on the sea, some decor and furniture are simple and starting to age with the building, and email contact is sometimes slow, so call or message on LINE instead · Best for families visiting navy personnel, people on official business, seminar groups, and anyone using Sattahip as a base for beach trips.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Many room types at the starting rate don't include breakfast — add it to your package or plan to head out to the Sattahip market and the cafes around the hotel · If you have questions before your stay, reviews say calling or messaging the hotel on LINE gets a faster answer than email.
pros: The only stay in the group with an outdoor swimming pool on site
Clean, spacious rooms, comfortable beds, cold air-con · great value
Has a seminar/banquet room and an in-house Thai restaurant · free parking
Near Toei Ngam Beach, Nang Ram Beach, and U-Tapao Airport
cons: Many rooms at the starting rate don't include breakfast
In central town, not on the sea, relies mainly on a car
Some decor is simple and starting to age · email replies are slow

entries.type: Hilltop Guest House 2★ · on the hill with a bay view
entries.name: Makmai Sailom Heights
entries.badge: ⛰️ On the hill in the breeze · famous restaurant on site
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Sukhumvit 81 on the hill · near Dongtan Beach 5 min
entries.addr: 93/1 Moo 6, Soi Sukhumvit 81, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Makmai Sailom Heights plays with location like no other in this group — a small stay of about 8–13 rooms set on a hill above the Makmai Sailom Heights restaurant, which locals know well for its sea views and its makmai yam dishes, its stance clear right from the name "Sailom" (breeze) and "Heights" · The point real reviews mention most is the elevated location that gets both a cool breeze and a wide, far-reaching view of Sattahip Bay from above, which typical beachfront stays can't offer — every room is designed with a private balcony to catch the breeze and take in the view, especially at sunset, which many call "worth more than the price" · Another advantage is that it has a well-known restaurant in the same place, so you don't have to drive far for dinner — the restaurant is known for its makmai yam (crispy fried wild betel leaves with yam dressing) and offers Thai food and seafood, with reviews on Wongnai and Tripadvisor praising it as tasty and good value · There's Wi-Fi and free parking, near Dongtan Beach at about 5 min, Wat Khao Noi less than a kilometre away, and U-Tapao at about 16 km, from just ฿850/night · Honest caveats: there's no swimming pool, it's a simple 2-star stay, the hillside entrance up the soi is fairly remote and dark at night so keep GPS navigation on, breakfast terms differ across platforms so check clearly, and the location is easiest with your own car · Best for couples and anyone who wants to sleep in the breeze on the hill, take in the bay view, then eat at a well-known restaurant all in one place.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The entrance is on a hill up a soi (accessible from Sukhumvit 81 or 89), remote and dark at night — keep GPS navigation on and plan to arrive before dusk your first time · Each room faces a different way for the view, so ask for a room with a bay-view balcony right when you book, and try the makmai yam at the on-site restaurant.
pros: Hilltop location, cool breeze and a Sattahip bay view from above, every room with a balcony
Well-known Makmai Sailom restaurant on site, chill and watch the sunset
Spacious, open, clean rooms, comfortable sleep · good value (from reviews)
Quiet · free Wi-Fi and parking · near Dongtan Beach and U-Tapao
cons: No swimming pool · a simple 2-star stay
The hillside entrance up the soi is fairly remote and dark at night
Breakfast terms differ across platforms · this area needs a car

entries.type: Guest House 2★ · small stay near Dongtan Beach
entries.name: Pob Choke Residences
entries.revCount: average about 7.5 · from reviews across all platforms
entries.badge: 🔥 BBQ garden · near Dongtan-Nang Ram beaches
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sattahip · near Dongtan-Nang Ram beaches · U-Tapao 13 km
entries.addr: 39/3 Moo 6, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Pob Choke Residences is the stay with the lightest starting price in this article at around ฿585/night — a small stay of about 15–20 rooms in the zone near Dongtan Beach and Nang Ram Beach, positioned as the budget choice for anyone who wants to enjoy the Sattahip-side sea quietly, averaging about 7.5 from reviews across all platforms · The point real reviews mention most is that the rooms are more spacious than expected for this price and clean, with comfortable beds, every room with a private balcony to sit and catch the morning breeze, some reviews praising the view from the balcony in the morning, plus friendly, attentive staff and a quiet atmosphere that really does escape the bustle of Pattaya · Its distinctive selling point is the garden and BBQ corner, where groups of friends or families buy fresh ingredients and seafood from the Sattahip market and grill their own BBQ at the property in the quiet garden setting, with free Wi-Fi, free parking, and a 24-hour front desk, a short drive from Dongtan Beach and Nang Ram Beach, and only about 13 km from U-Tapao · Honest caveats: there's no swimming pool, the bedding is small separate blankets rather than a duvet, which some people aren't used to, soundproofing is so-so, food options at the property are limited, and the location is fairly far from the main sights, so you have to drive out, and it's easiest with your own car · Best for couples, groups of friends, and families who drive in to enjoy the Sattahip sea quietly and on a budget and want to do a BBQ.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want to use the BBQ corner and garden, coordinate with the property in advance and plan to buy fresh ingredients and seafood from the Sattahip market yourself · The bedding is small separate blankets and soundproofing is so-so, so if you want a thick duvet or are sensitive to noise, ask and prepare in advance.
pros: Lowest price in the article from ฿585 · rooms more spacious than expected, clean
Every room has a private balcony, sit and catch the morning breeze
Garden and BBQ corner to grill with friends · free parking · 24-hour front desk
Near Dongtan-Nang Ram beaches and U-Tapao Airport about 13 km
cons: No swimming pool (mainly sells the quiet)
Bedding is small separate blankets · so-so soundproofing
Limited food options at the property · location far from sights, need to drive

entries.type: Budget Resort 3★ · single-storey resort near the naval base
entries.name: Sor Kor Sor Resort
entries.badge: ⚓ Near the naval base · park at your door
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Sukhumvit 45 off Sukhumvit Rd · near the naval base 5 min
tags: 🛏️ Spacious room, soft bed, good value
entries.addr: 25/100 Soi Sukhumvit 45, Moo 3, Sukhumvit Road, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: We close with Sor Kor Sor Resort, the budget resort that scores best in the resort group of this article at 8.8 from 28 reviews — a single-storey resort of about 49 rooms arranged around a parking yard off Sukhumvit Road in the Sattahip stretch, selling simplicity that's "more than the price," run as a local family business · The point real reviews most agree on is that rooms are more spacious than the price, clean, with soft beds, a choice of pillows both soft and firm, and good cold air-con, plus the advantage that self-drivers love most — a single-storey building where you park right at your door — and free private parking · The location matters for many because it's only about a 5 min drive from the Sattahip naval base and the Krom Luang Chumphon Monument, ideal for people here on navy business, dropping off relatives reporting for duty, or attending a ceremony, near Nang Ram and Dongtan beaches, and about 15–20 min from U-Tapao · There's a BBQ yard to grill, a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi, and an airport shuttle (for a fee), with service praised for friendliness and honesty — one review tells of leaving something behind and the staff tracking them down to return it · Honest caveats: there's no swimming pool and breakfast isn't included, there's no in-house restaurant, the building has been open a while so some rooms look aged, and it's right by Sukhumvit Road, so rooms facing the road may hear passing traffic · Best for families driving themselves, people on business around the naval base, and budget travelers stopping over en route.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's right by Sukhumvit Road with some passing traffic noise — if you're a light sleeper, ask for a room that doesn't face the road or an inner room right when you book · There's no in-house restaurant and no breakfast included, so plan your meals around the made-to-order shops and the market in Sattahip district nearby.
pros: Rooms more spacious than the price, clean, soft beds, a choice of pillows
Free parking right at your door, very convenient for self-drivers
Near the Sattahip naval base 5 min · easy on and off Sukhumvit Road
Friendly and honest staff · 24-hour counter
cons: No swimming pool, no in-house restaurant, and no breakfast included
The building has been open a while, some rooms look aged
Right by Sukhumvit Road, road-facing rooms may hear traffic · need a car

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room price range and may change by date and season — we recommend checking the real price and comparing 3 sites before every booking · The scores and highlights in this article come from reading guests' real reviews on booking platforms, not from staying ourselves · All stays are in Sattahip District, Chonburi Province, a seaside zone at the southern tip just past Pattaya · The key thing to know is that Sattahip is easiest with your own car or a rental, because public transport isn't as dense as in Pattaya city · Many stays are only 12–18 km from U-Tapao Airport (UTP), ideal for anyone flying in directly · Some beaches are within navy areas with entry rules and opening hours, so check before you go · During long holidays and festivals when people flock to the Sattahip sea, rooms fill fast and prices rise, so book ahead · Article by Thailandaddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travelers often ask about stays in Sattahip, Chonburi

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best stay in Sattahip?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style · By review score and being on the sea, Baan Sattahip by the sea scores 9.2, the highest in the article, every room a bay view · For local atmosphere on a light budget, Sattahiptale has a rooftop bay view and dorms from a few hundred · For a house with a kitchen when coming as a group, Baan Klang-Dao Resort · For a hotel with a pool, My Home Hotel (Baan Mai Hom) · For naval-base business or a budget, Sor Kor Sor Resort and SiriNiran, with standout service

faq.q: ❓ How much do stays in Sattahip cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at around ฿585–1,600 per night · On the lightest side are Pob Choke Residences from ฿585 and SiriNiran from ฿700 · Mid-range are Sattahiptale ฿800, My Home ฿800, Makmai Sailom Heights ฿850, Sor Kor Sor ฿900, and The Brass Villa and Baan Klang-Dao at ฿1,000 · At the top is Baan Sattahip by the sea from ฿1,600, traded for a bay view filling the window · Prices are approximate starting rates from standard rooms, and during long holidays and festivals prices may be higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ Do you need your own car for Sattahip?
faq.a: You don't have to, but having your own car or a rental is easiest, because Sattahip is a town where public transport isn't as dense as in Pattaya city, and many stays require driving out to the beach and restaurants · Most stays in this article have free parking · Without a car you have to rely on Grab or a taxi, which can be hard to get at times, so allow extra time and travel budget, especially when heading into Pattaya city (about 30–50 min) · The options within walking distance of the market and the sea are Baan Sattahip by the sea and Sattahiptale in the bayfront/old-market area

faq.q: ❓ Which stays in Sattahip are on the sea or have a sea view?
faq.a: If you want a sea view from the room directly, Baan Sattahip by the sea is a bayfront guesthouse where most rooms face the sea · If you want a bay view from above on the hill, choose Makmai Sailom Heights, where every room has a bay-view balcony · If you want a rooftop sea view, choose Sattahiptale · As for Pob Choke, Baan Klang-Dao, SiriNiran, My Home, Sor Kor Sor, and The Brass Villa, they're in town or in a garden, so you drive a short way to Dongtan, Nang Ram, or Toei Ngam beaches

faq.q: ❓ Are there any stays in Sattahip with a swimming pool?
faq.a: In the set we've reviewed, My Home Hotel (Baan Mai Hom Hotel) is the only one with an outdoor swimming pool on site, because it's a full 3-star hotel · Most other stays in the article are guesthouses, houses, and small resorts that focus on atmosphere, view, and quiet, so they have no pool · If a swim matters for this trip, choose My Home Hotel or consider a beachfront resort in the Bang Saray/Jomtien zone at a higher price level again

faq.q: ❓ What is there to do in Sattahip · how many days is enough?
faq.a: Sattahip has clear-water beaches within navy areas like Nang Ram Beach, Dongtan Beach, and Toei Ngam Beach (some spots have entry rules, so check first), the Royal Thai Navy Sea Turtle Conservation Centre, Wat Sattahip (Luang Pho I), the Krom Luang Chumphon Memorial, a morning market and fresh seafood restaurants, and the boat pier out to Koh Samaesan with its clear water · It suits a 2–3 day getaway, using your stay as a base to drive to the beaches and eat seafood · In high season and on long holidays the small stays fill fast, so book ahead and compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
